detailed_description: Discount Calculator works out the final price after one or more percentage discounts. Enter the original price, type a discount percentage or pick one of the 10/15/20/25/30/50 preset buttons, and optionally add extra percentage discounts that are applied in sequence on the already-reduced price. Click Calculate to see the final price (formatted in US dollars with Intl.NumberFormat), the amount saved, the combined discount percentage, and a breakdown row for each applied discount. The tool only formats numbers as USD and does not pick from multiple currencies, choose decimal precision, save scenarios, compare retailers side by side, or batch-process price lists.
usage_steps: Enter the original price in the price input
Type a discount percentage or click one of the preset buttons (10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 50)
Click + Add Discount to chain extra percentage discounts; each one applies on the previous reduced price
Use the X button to remove an additional discount row you no longer need
Click Calculate to compute the final price
Read the final price card, amount saved, total discount percentage, and the per-discount breakdown
usage_examples: Work out the checkout price of a $100 item with a single 20% discount
Stack a 20% off coupon on top of a 15% sale to see the combined final price
Compare what a 25% versus 30% discount changes the saved amount on the same price
Quickly read the total discount percentage when several offers are applied in sequence
